summary.text: Doug Lloyd is the Republican nominee for Michigan Attorney General and has been Eaton County prosecuting attorney since 2013. His campaign cites more than 30 years as a prosecutor and a term as president of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan.

paragraphs.text: Appointed Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney in 2013 by the county's circuit judges and subsequently won four consecutive elections, including the county's first contested prosecutor's race since 1972.
Previously served as assistant prosecutor, senior assistant prosecutor in the Economic Crimes Unit, and chief assistant prosecutor in Eaton County.
President of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan, 2021-2022; appointed in 2013 by Gov. Rick Snyder to the Organized Retail Fraud Advisory Board.
